summary: Executed backend+frontend regression on public preview for Studio/Admin. Core guest studio/cart/checkout flows passed, but admin auth is blocked by Origin checks and text assistant LLM calls fail at provider request validation.

critical.issue: Returns 403 "Nicht erlaubter Ursprung der Anfrage." even with correct preview Origin header, blocking all admin auth/CRUD scenarios.
SSE returns error event; backend log shows provider 400: Anthropic model `claude-sonnet-5-5` rejects `temperature` parameter (deprecated), so free-wish text assistant cannot produce proposals.

integration_issues.issue: Valid admin credentials show server error banner `Nicht erlaubter Ursprung der Anfrage.`; dashboard never opens.
Text-AI request fails and design remains unchanged due backend/provider parameter incompatibility.

action_items: Fix admin Origin validation so legitimate preview-origin requests are accepted; then retest login, cookie rotation, brute-force lockout, and full admin product CRUD (upload/area persistence/version conflict/archive/reactivate).

Update assistant provider call for `claude-sonnet-5-5` to remove/adjust deprecated `temperature` parameter in backend/studio/assistant.py, then retest exactly two same-session multi-turn text requests and apply/undo persistence.
After admin auth fix, complete pending circle/rectangle boundary regression (tiny circle edge constraints, saved draft vs revised product-version conflict handling) end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: `same_origin()` currently hard-fails admin POST/PUT/DELETE login/mutations in deployed preview context, making Rohlingverwaltung unusable despite correct credentials.
Assistant integration is wired but currently incompatible with model runtime: logs show BadRequest from provider because `temperature` is deprecated for configured model.
Guided flow behaved correctly: no `/api/studio/assistant/message` and no `/api/studio/drafts/*/preview` calls during guided steps, save, cart, and checkout.
Responsive checks at 320/768/1024/1440 had no horizontal overflow and canvas remained visible/scaled (observed CSS widths: 286px/393px/640px/640px).

success_rate.backend: 67% (10 passed, 4 failed, 1 skipped in targeted studio suite)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Test guest/order data created via API only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin flows are currently blocked at auth entrypoint (403 Origin). Studio core guest flows remain healthy and checkout test order persists (0 payment). Assistant SSE endpoint responds but only with error event due provider parameter mismatch; backend error trace captured in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log.
rca of the issue: 1) Admin RCA: `/api/admin/auth/login` returns 403 with detail `Nicht erlaubter Ursprung der Anfrage.` even when requests include preview Origin. Likely origin-list mismatch/parsing/runtime value issue in `same_origin` comparison, causing legitimate browser-origin mutations to be rejected. Repro: POST login from /verwaltung or curl with Origin=preview URL. 2) Assistant RCA: `/api/studio/assistant/message` fails in stream; logs show Anthropic invalid_request_error: `temperature` deprecated for model `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Repro: create guest + session + POST assistant message; response emits status then error event, design unchanged.
